description_en: Cancels the automatic update configuration for a specified data flow
description_zh: 取消指定数据流动上的自动更新配置
kebab_example: aliyun nas cancel-data-flow-auto-refresh --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --data-flow-id df-194433a5be310000 --refresh-path /prefix1/prefix2/ --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelDataFlowAutoRefresh

parameters.help_en:
The directory for which you want to cancel the automatic update configuration.

Limits:

The length must be 2 to 1,024 characters.
The value must be encoded in UTF-8.
The value must start and end with a forward slash (/).

The directory must be an existing directory in CPFS and must be in a fileset for which data flow is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
需要取消自动更新配置的目录。

限制：

长度为2~1024个字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以正斜线（/）开头和结尾。

该目录必须是CPFS上的已有目录，且必须位于开启了数据流动的Fileset中
parameters.name: refresh_path

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request.

A dry run checks parameter validity and resource availability without actually creating the instance or incurring fees.

Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request without creating the data flow. The dry run checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business dependencies are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, HTTP status code 200 is returned, but DataFlowId is empty.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check succeeds, the instance is directly created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检。

预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、校验库存等，并不会实际创建实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建数据流动。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode，但DataFlowld为空。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests.

The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同的请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
